title: feat: add admin delete-user endpoint
description: New admin-only endpoint under /api/admin for deleting users by id. Wired for the admin dashboard team's cleanup workflow.
notes: Introduces a new admin route with no authentication or role check whatsoever — any unauthenticated caller can delete any user. All other admin routes in this repo wrap the handler in withAuth({ role: 'admin' }). One expected finding.
